nodes.speaker: Shrine keeper
nodes.text: You walk this road in the fog? Few do, these days. Fewer come back the same.

choices.text: What lies beyond the shrine gate?
Thank you for opening the gate.

nodes.speaker: Shrine keeper
nodes.text: I have kept this shrine since before the fields were flooded. Someone must sweep the steps, even when no one climbs them.

nodes.speaker: Shrine keeper
nodes.text: The grounds behind the gate are not for idle visitors. Why would you go there?

choices.text: I only want to pay my respects.
I heard something calling from inside.

nodes.speaker: Shrine keeper
nodes.text: You bowed at the torii. I saw. Very well... the gate will open for you. Do not stay after the cicadas stop.

nodes.speaker: Shrine keeper
nodes.text: Then you should go home. Things that call from behind that gate are not asking for visitors.

choices.text: What lies beyond the shrine gate?
